target.projection_interpretation: planar XZ; support/projection normal is local Y

matrix_test.candidate_euler_family: Rz * Ry * Rx for column-vector support pose
matrix_test.interpretation: The stored rotation behaves like the pose/orientation of the planar projection support. Geometry must be transformed by the inverse rotation into projection-local coordinates. Direct application makes the projection axis nearly perpendicular to the textured face.

evidence_boundary: This strongly distinguishes inverse versus direct application for code-400 planar support orientation.

Because the target has Y rotation exactly zero, it does not uniquely distinguish all six possible three-axis Euler orders; it supports the existing Rz*Ry*Rx family but a full three-axis geometric oracle is still desirable before declaring Euler order complete.
The test concerns model-local relation code 400. Relation code 401 is a separate material-level path and is not assumed to share every application-stage detail without validation.
